Fields.Name: Depth of Field Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns depth of field on for this level.

Fields.Name: Force High Resolution Blur
Fields.Description: Overrides the scene's high-resolution blur setting: -1 forces it off, 0 keeps the scene's setting, 1 forces it on.

Fields.Name: Maximum Blur Level
Fields.Description: Caps the blur quality level: 2 full quality, 1 one step lower, 0 lowest. A lower level set by the scene is kept.
